an5.98:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bahulīkaronto nacirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati.
an5.98:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu appaṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo hoti susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu.
an5.98:1.8: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bahulīkaronto na cirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatīti.
